title: lathyrus luteus
intro: Lathyrus luteus, commonly known as the yellow pea or flat pea, is a perennial legume plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It is a traditional medicinal plant used in various cultures, particularly in Europe and Asia, due to its health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus luteus include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified in various studies as contributing to its medicinal properties.
